digest.en: Malaysia's foreign minister is calling for a review of the UN refugee agency's presence, while rescue teams in Japan search for survivors after a deadly earthquake. In the Middle East, a US sanctions bill targeting Russia and Iran has garnered bipartisan support in Congress.
